The narrative adheres to the rendering instructions: each round includes all required blocks, avoids extraneous confounds, stays event-based and non-meta, and maintains coherent timestamps and evolution of positions and payoffs. Any omissions (e.g., lack of explicit enforcement actions or news shocks) are consistent with rules framed as possibilities rather than necessities and do not distort the tested dynamics. As a result, any residual imperfections are minor and do not meaningfully contaminate the behavioral interpretation, supporting a highly_valid overall rating.
